SUMMARY
Instructional designer with a decade of classroom teaching behind me. I completed an instructional design certificate in 2025 and have since built e-learning modules for two corporate clients. I design measurable, learner-centred training using ADDIE and backward design.

- Storyboarded and scripted a 10-part microlearning series in Rise 360 for a healthcare staffing company.
